description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different models on the November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests, comparing large and small models across various categories. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, listed in a specific order, while the vertical axis represents the average score, ranging from 60 to 90, with a label indicating that the temperature is set to 0.5. The chart features paired bars for each model, with light blue representing large models and dark blue representing small models. The average scores for the models are as follows: Llama 70B instruct has a score of approximately 66.4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet has a score of around 74.8, Qwen 14b-instruct has scores of 77.4 for the small model and 77.9 for the large model, GPT 4o has scores of 77.9 for the large model and 78.2 for the small model, Owen 2.5 72b-instruct has scores of 78.7 for both models, Gemini Flash 1.5 has scores of 81.6 for both models, Gemini Pro 1.5 has scores of 89.8 for both models, and phi-4 has a score of approximately 91.8 for the small model. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and some models have identical scores for both large and small versions, while others show slight variations. The chart includes error bars representing two times the estimate.
